svg.title: Invana architecture
svg.desc: The services Invana runs (studio, engine, Postgres, graph databases, HyperDX, LLM providers) and the modules inside Studio and the engine, with designed but unbuilt pieces dashed.
svg.text: The services that run, then the modules inside each. Current design as of October 2026.
Ports are the docker-compose host ports.
inside it, as an asyncio task
workers on N servers pull runs from a durable
OTLP gRPC · browser OTLP via proxy
Shell — one layout, every screen fills its regions
Libraries — one direction: design-kit → canvas → studio
every graph Studio draws — WebGPU first, WebGL fallback
canvas chrome: style editors · panels · controls
also in the repo — transitive, or not used by Studio
every component Studio renders — shadcn + TailwindCSS 4
also in the kit — not yet used by Studio
Python 3.14 · FastAPI · SQLAlchemy async · uv · Ruff · pytest
server — FastAPI routers, one per module
activity — who did what, for whom, caused by what
integrations/ — separate pip packages, one per database
vendor connectors that extend graph/connectors, loaded by dotted path

Sources: docker-compose.yml · engine/pyproject.toml (import-linter bands) · studio/package.json · design-kit/packages · canvas/packages. Update this diagram when a service, a band or a package changes.
